purpose: Summarize independently screened external island mechanism bridges without converting partial links, source availability, or within-system replication into a formal cross-system causal fit.

systems.strength: direct per-visit/service and reproductive-dependency evidence with floral response, but cross-year/cross-paper linkage
broad island-mainland visitation and direct autofertility plus reproductive-assurance and floral-transition recurrence, but no matched per-visit pollen function

one source-defined two-island system contains floral morph-state divergence, pollinator-environment contrast, single-visit pollen deposition and controlled reproductive dependence, but effectiveness/dependency are not matched on Dong Island

why_formal_fit_remains_closed: No external system yet supplies all mechanism links at a matched two-sided population/transition unit.
The three systems do not yet supply one compatible mechanism estimand family with source-locked uncertainty across at least two independent clusters.
Nicotiana has cross-year/cross-paper linkage, Caribbean Gesneriaceae lacks matched per-visit pollen function, and Cordia lacks Dong-side direct effectiveness and controlled dependency measurements.
Partial mechanistic recurrence cannot substitute for Issue #91 direct Izu field measurements.
next_decision_gate: Prioritize source recovery or new data that close the missing effectiveness/dependency side of Cordia or identify another system with floral response, direct visitor pollen function, and reproductive dependency measured at the same transition units.
claim_boundary: Three independent partial bridge systems strengthen the plausibility and generality of the mechanism architecture and reveal alternative mechanisms, but they do not establish a universal island response, a universal dependency coefficient, historical pollinator-loss causation, or a formal cross-system causal model.
